implemented.full_entry_guard: Default DatabaseSeeder rejects protected databases before Auth/master/business writes; no break-glass grant is introduced.
implemented.coverage: Preflight, default PostgreSQL chain and DailySkuCoverageSeeder validate the same explicit HN_DAILY_COVERAGE_DAYS process input. Missing/invalid/overflow input fails; no cached .env assumption or implicit 0/14 at those entrypoints.
implemented.run_boundary: A PostgreSQL session advisory lock serializes the default full-chain invocation without a whole-chain transaction. An in-memory before-ID boundary restricts late enrichment to new rows in an exclusive disposable clone; it is not historical provenance.
implemented.late_hints: FinalFixtureLocationSeeder runs after all existing phases, including DailySkuCoverageSeeder. It conditionally fills only new item IDs with null hints, without modifying existing locations, timestamps, status or condition.
implemented.display: DisplayFieldCoverageSeeder requires an active run scope, restricts sample trays/mappings and import error files to new eligible rows, rejects unowned tray-code collisions, and does not synthesize cancelled evidence or rewrite historical line notes.
implemented.required_failure: SeedStrictCommand makes unclassified standard warn/error calls fatal with sanitized phase information, including legacy warnings requiring review. It does not assert earlier phases or filesystem writes rolled back. Informational verified-replay skips remain distinct.
